newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P raises Peabody Australia CP rating to A-1.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P raises Peabody Australia CP rating to A-1.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said it raised its commercial paper rating on Peabody Australia Holdings Ltd to A-1 from A-2 and removed the rating from CreditWatch.
The rating action follows the release of further financial information on the demerger of its businesses by Hanson Plc, S&P said.
S&P said Hanson is in the final phase of a voluntary break-up of its businesses with the energy business to be demerged in early 1997.
Post demerger, The Energy Group Plc will constitute a diversified energy business with substantial interests in coal and power generation and distribution.
Its main businesses will be Eastern Group Plc, a British regional electricity company, and Peabody Coal of the United States, S&P said.
Commercial paper issued by Peabody Australia is currently guaranteed by Hanson.
But after the merger, The Energy Group will become the guarantor, S&P said.

Energy Group's ratings will benefit from the low-risk operation of the Eastern Group monopoly power distribution business as well as Peabody Coal's above-average position as the largest private producer of coal in the world, it said.
"The combined entity is expected to have a manageable debt burden, adequate coverage ratios and strong cash flow levels," S&P added.
